scenes.title: Who Is Boss of the House
scenes.summary: Opening in playful Shakespearean verse, Max plays video games instead of fixing the broken shower head, until an exasperated Vika grabs the wrench and fixes it herself.

scenes.title: Winter Tires
scenes.summary: When movers deliver new furniture to the apartment, Vika takes charge of the heavy lifting and reminds Max that he still hasn't changed the tires on her car.

scenes.title: Lyova's Moustache
scenes.summary: Sous-chef Lyova returns from vacation in Turkey sporting a thick moustache just like Chef Barinov's after listening to a psychology audiobook on mirroring an opponent.

scenes.title: Darkness in the Dining Room
scenes.summary: While Nagiyev is trying to impress a glamorous woman in the dining room, the electricity suddenly cuts out, and Nagiyev orders Denis to play romantic piano music in the dark.

scenes.title: A Snake in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: In the alley, Vika hopes Barinov and German are calling a truce, until German accuses Barinov of cutting the electricity and Barinov learns German put a live snake in his kitchen.

scenes.title: The Missing Sommelier
scenes.summary: At his candlelit table, Nagiyev calls Nastya by the wrong name before reading her badge and learns that the restaurant's sommelier has disappeared on a drinking binge.

scenes.title: The Mirror Method
scenes.summary: Following his psychology audiobook's advice to copy his opponent's posture and facial expressions, Lyova mimics every move Chef Barinov makes until Barinov throws him out.

scenes.title: Part-Time Musician
scenes.summary: When the lights come back on, Nagiyev's date storms out after learning he cannot get her onto The Voice, and Nagiyev hires Denis part-time for his piano playing.

scenes.title: The Line at the Tire Shop
scenes.summary: Max stays out late celebrating Denis's new musician job with Kostya, and when he sneaks home at night without changing Vika's tires, he blames a fictional queue.

scenes.title: The Aroma of France
scenes.summary: Lyova catches Chef Barinov blowing the stench of ripe French cheese through an air vent into Claude Monet, and Lyova's sarcastic remark about cockroaches gives Barinov his next idea.

scenes.title: Stuck in the Elevator
scenes.summary: While German blames the cheese smell in Claude Monet on Senya, Max and Vika get trapped inside their building's elevator, and Barinov unleashes cockroaches next door.

scenes.title: The Broken Bottle
scenes.summary: At the bar, Kostya drops an expensive bottle of wine and gets fined by Nagiyev, shocking Nastya, while in the elevator Vika asks a passerby to call Denis.

scenes.title: The New Sommelier
scenes.summary: Determined to save their family budget, Nastya flatters Nagiyev into giving Kostya a trial as the new sommelier that evening, despite Kostya's total ignorance of wine.

scenes.title: The Tasting Lesson
scenes.summary: Lyova begs Barinov to stop acting like a child with the cockroaches, while at the bar Nastya pours Kostya a glass of wine to test his nonexistent sommelier skills.

scenes.title: The Musical Clue
scenes.summary: Denis comes up with a clever plan to play different national melodies on the piano to signal each wine's country to Kostya, while Barinov patches the hole in the wall for Lyova.

scenes.title: Talking to the Dispatcher
scenes.summary: Still trapped in the elevator, Max argues with the rude maintenance voice over the intercom and boasts to Vika that real men get results by threatening to break noses.

scenes.title: The Tough Mechanic
scenes.summary: A giant elevator mechanic pries the doors open to confront the guy who threatened him, and as Max hides behind Vika, the mechanic's own tiny wife bosses him around.

scenes.title: The Sommelier Exam
scenes.summary: During Nagiyev's blind wine test, Kostya uses Denis's piano melodies to guess the first bottle's country and year, and when Nagiyev stops the music, Kostya reads the second label in a reflection!

scenes.title: Stolen Wheels and a Guest
scenes.summary: Lyova catches Barinov reopening the wall hole and shaves off his moustache right before German blasts the wall down, Max and Vika find her car wheels stolen, and Sasha returns to book her wedding!
